title: Dispatch
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.11 and Section 6 (Contingencies) of SOP-06, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 139-142 = PDF pages 145-148). Step text is the Key Step column verbatim. Note: the manual numbers this SOP's contingency steps 1.1-1.3 in Section 6 while Section 4 refers to them as 6.1-6.3; they are cited here as 6.1-6.3. Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Endorse signed Shipping Documents (BL/PTR/RIS) and shipment plan to Store Supervisor
Notify Security Personnel for incoming pick-up/dispatch schedule

Check the appropriateness of the vehicle and ensure the following: check for leaks and sharp edges which could damage commodities during transport; if commodities for dispatch require controlled temperature storage, ensure that the vehicle is well air-conditioned which contains temperature and relative humidity measuring units; if applicable, ensure GPS and Transportation monitoring mechanisms are well-functioning

Perform Contingency Step 6.1: inform the warehouse manager and report to the courier pertaining to the incident; reschedule the releasing accordingly and provide supporting reports for the KPI monitoring of the 3PL
steps.condition: the vehicle is unfit to transport the allocated items

steps.text: Hand over items to 3PL/recipient for counter checking
steps.condition: the vehicle is fit to transport the allocated items

steps.text: Perform Contingency Step 6.2: perform physical inspection of the warehouse to locate products; if products are located, update the documents accordingly; if not, investigate, review all CCTVs if necessary and produce Incident Report (Annex 16) and inform the Store Manager and Supply Officer
steps.condition: there are missing items discovered during checking of 3PL/recipient

steps.text: Perform Contingency Step 6.3: take photos of the damaged item/s and facilitate investigation on its occurrence; produce Incident Report (Annex 16) and inform the Store Manager and Supply Officer
steps.condition: there are damaged items discovered during checking of 3PL/recipient

steps.text: Supervise 3PL/recipient in loading the allocated commodities. Ensure that loaders/porters properly stack all commodities in the vehicle. If applicable, instruct 3PL/recipient to put cling/plastic wrap on stacks and fill up free spaces in the vehicle with bubble wraps, cartons, or any other non-hazardous fillers to maintain stability between stacks and prevent packaging damages during transportation
Countercheck items for dispatch and prepare Gate Pass for signature of the approving authority (Store Manager/Store Supervisor). Endorse to 3PL/recipient
Ensure that the 3PL representative/recipient has properly stamped Shipping Documents and Gate Pass with a copy of official ID as attachment. Hand over to Store Manager for counter checking and filing
Update Outbound records and Monthly Inventory Report and endorse to Store Manager for checking
Update Stock Cards and endorse to the Store Manager for checking
Consolidate, countercheck and file carbon copy of Shipping Documents and gate pass stamped by the courier/recipient. Provide a copy to the Supply Officer and/or Monitoring Unit
Produce/Update RSMI/SSMI and send to payment section/accounting
